children: The NYSE American Committee for Review affirmed the decision to delist TechCreate’s Class A ordinary shares. The board will not pursue a further challenge; the shares continue to be quoted OTC under TCGLF.
Board will not further challenge delisting
The company is not pursuing another appeal, leaving the delisting process to proceed.
The exchange upheld its prior decision; delisting is expected if the decision is not called for review by exchange directors.
Shares continue to be quoted OTC as TCGLF
OTC quotation continues, but the release says the exchange is expected to proceed with delisting if no review is requested.

This is a late-stage update in an existing delisting proceeding, following the panel decision and the committee review. The next catalyst is whether an Exchange director requests board review and whether the company receives notice that the decision is final.
